s.how: Bake 12 frozen party pies at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve hot with tomato sauce. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Slice 3 red apples and serve with 200g sliced cheddar on a board. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Mix 300g shredded cooked chicken with 4 tbsp mayonnaise. Fill 6 sandwiches with the chicken and lettuce and cut into triangles. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Cut a sponge cake into squares. Mix 250g icing sugar, 30g cocoa and hot water into a thin icing, dip each square and roll in 150g coconut.

d.how: Chill 750ml sparkling wine and 1.25L lemonade. Pour into flutes. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
